thread:
Sam: Hey team — thinking of a low-key indoor picnic + open mic next Friday (weatherproof!). 6pm in the big common area? Bring a snack or a short song/story if you want. :guitar:
Anya: love this. i can bring hummus + pita. what time should folks arrive?
Jade: 6pm works. i'd like to do a 3-song open mic slot, sign-up?
Mike: count me in for bringing cups and napkins. can we also do a tiny donation jar for snacks? :coin:
Ravi: vegan/peanut-free options please — i can make a chickpea salad.
event-bot: Quick poll! React with :one: if you'd like to perform, :two: if you're only eating, :three: if both. (poll expires in 48h)
Sam: poll link pinned — and here's a simple sign-up sheet: https://short.ly/rw-picnic (please add if performing).
Anya: @Jade you okay with audio? we have a small bluetooth speaker.
Jade: yep speaker is fine, mike can you bring a mic stand?
Mike: i have a spare mic + stand, i'll drop it off at 5:30 for setup.
Ravi: can we do a label for allergens? i'll print small tent cards.
Sam: great idea. i'll make a tiny template, pasting here:
```
Snack: Chickpea Salad
Allergens: None
Vegan: Yes
Serves: ~8
```
Anya: i'll add hummus card. also maybe ambient playlist? i can queue something chill.
Jade: open mic sign-ups: @Sam, @Jade, @Ravi, @Alex? (Alex hasn't responded)
Sam: Alex pinged me earlier, said maybe. i'll nudge in #general tomorrow.
Ravi: budget note — if folks want to chip in for extra supplies, i can Venmo @ravi (or we set up a jar).
Mike: :thumbsup: jar sounds easiest. i'll keep cash box at reception.
Anya: RSVP please by Wednesday so we know seating. i'll make a quick headcount table in the sheet.
Sam: awesome, thanks all. tiny ask: keep amplification low so it's chill for those who just want to eat/chat. :sparkles: 
Jade: agreed. also if anyone wants to bring a board game after the mic, bring small ones!
Ravi: see you Friday. excited.
event-bot: Reminder set for Thursday 12:00: "Indoor picnic open mic — finalize RSVP"
Mike: logistix note: we'll clear the long table and set up a rug/soft seating area too. volunteers to help move chairs at 5:15?
Anya: i'll help. Sam?
Sam: yep i'll be there.
Jade: me too.
Sam: thanks everyone — will update the sheet with final layout on Thursday. :raised_hands:
